summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute a 727 KB obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package declares a preinstall script `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes `bun math_init.js` against a sibling file shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a single-line ~727 KB blob using string-array rotation obfuscation (shift-rotator function, numeric constant table, hex-mangled identifiers) with no corresponding source in the repository and no relationship to the package's stated purpose (a Vue file-uploader component). Bun is fetched from its official project host, but it is used at install time to execute an opaque local payload under an alternate runtime that ordinary Node-based supply-chain scanners do not inspect. Installing the package auto-runs this obfuscated payload on the installer host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
